prompt:
Vertical 9:16 video, 15 seconds, one continuous scene. Clean realistic everyday video, soft natural daylight, shallow depth of field, calm and minimal.
Setting: Clean and tidy indoor plant shelf in a sunny room
Action:
[0-5s] A clean potted plant standing on a dry saucer on a wooden plant shelf. Camera: Static medium close-up.
[5-10s] Potted green plant with fresh foliage illuminated by soft sunlight. Camera: Slow tilt-up shot of the plant stem and leaves.
[10-15s] A hand reaching toward the plant pot to touch the soil in daylight. Camera: Close-up shot of hand approaching soil surface.
Audio: Calm and peaceful room tone with subtle breeze sound
Constraints: No human faces. No added text overlays, captions or subtitles. No background music. No speech, narration or voice-over.
